companyDescription: AI-powered satellite intelligence platform · Real-time Earth observation with sub-hourly revisit rates · $30M defense contract Apr 2026 · Golden Dome ISR layer = direct BKSY application · The AI-native eyes of the military and intelligence community
priceNote: Live $24.32 (+2.0%) on Nov 11, 2026 — up 44% from $16.91 at the Nov 4 report after the Nov 5 Q3 beat. The old Base target ($24.52) has been reached, so the old +45% Base is replaced by a new Base +15% ($27.97) anchored to the live price.
summary: The binary resolved in BlackSky's favour: Q3 (Nov 5) delivered record revenue of $42.8M, net income of $19M and record adjusted EBITDA of $13M, with full-year revenue and EBITDA guidance raised, and the stock ran +44% from the Nov 4 report — straight through the old Base target. What is left is a slower story: getting to the targeted eight Gen-3 satellites on orbit by year-end after earlier launch delays, Golden Dome ISR awards that remain undated, and proving Q3 margins were not flattered by a one-off two-month government Gen-3 pilot (an analyst read flags a soft Q4 setup). Cash is $231M with roughly -$12M quarterly free cash flow, so survival is clean. The asymmetry is much smaller than a week ago: Base is now +15% and the Moon case (+200%) needs Golden Dome plus a full Gen-3 constellation, so this is a ค่าขนม hold, not a fresh moonshot entry. Measured turbo median return to just after the catalyst is -4.0% (n=68): wait for the post-earnings gap to fill. Size 1–1.5% max.

catalysts.name: Eight Gen-3 satellites on orbit by year-end
catalysts.description: Management kept the target of eight Gen-3 satellites on orbit by end of 2026 despite earlier launch delays; it also said 2026 revenue does not depend on more launches. Hitting it de-risks 2027 capacity.

catalysts.name: Golden Dome ISR layer awards
catalysts.description: Space-based ISR requirement where BlackSky's real-time imagery fits; award timing is not public.

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 results — beat and raise
catalysts.description: Revenue $42.8M, net income $19M, record adjusted EBITDA $13M, full-year guidance raised; cash and investments $231.1M. Stock +44% since.

risks: Q3 was partly flattered by a seven-figure, two-month U.S. government Gen-3 pilot, so the 30% EBITDA margin is not a run rate; an analyst read calls the Q4 setup soft.
Gen-3 launches have slipped before; missing the eight-satellites-by-year-end target would push capacity and revenue growth into 2027.
After a +44% move, the highest named targets (~$38–42) imply limited upside versus a moonshot lane; much of the near-term good news is priced.
Revenue is concentrated in government and international defense customers; budget or contract timing shifts move results quarter to quarter.
Continued share issuance while holding $231M of cash would mean ongoing dilution despite positive operating cash flow.

estimateDates.note: Tests whether Q3 margins hold without the pilot

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed hiked 25bp on Sep 16, 2026 (first hike since 2023), and a hot October CPI (core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected) has pushed Dec 9 FOMC hike odds to roughly 89–100%, with the 10-year near 4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: October CPI ran hot (headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3%); October PCE on Nov 25 is the next inflation read.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Defense-space names have held up better than speculative tech, and BlackSky is now EBITDA-positive, so higher-for-longer rates matter less here than for pre-revenue peers; the risk is multiple compression after a +44% run.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — a priced-in December hike pressures high-multiple small caps, but government demand and positive EBITDA cushion BlackSky relative to the rest of the lane.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Space intelligence companies historically run 40-100% in the 4-8 weeks before major government ISR contract announcements. Golden Dome ISR awards expected H2 2026 — BKSY could pre-run into that decision window.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: 4-8 สัปดาห์ก่อน Golden Dome ISR contract announcements

postWin.note: Planet Labs (PL) +85% in 2 months on NOAA and DoD contract expansions in 2024. Satellogic +120% on multi-year DoD ISR contract. BKSY's $30M April contract already showed the pattern — next contract 3-5x larger could generate proportionally larger move.

postLose.note: BlackSky missed a major NGA contract in 2023, falling 40% from its prior high. Losing the Golden Dome ISR bid would trigger a similar selloff — especially if Planet Labs or Umbra wins the prime.

comparableCases.event: NOAA Commercial Weather Data + DoD ISR Expansion
comparableCases.note: Planet Labs +85% in 2 months on combined NOAA weather data contract + DoD ISR expansion. BlackSky Spectra AI is the next-generation equivalent — AI-processed real-time ISR vs raw satellite imagery. BKSY's Golden Dome win would trigger the same institutional re-rating.

MAXAR Technologies +60% in 30 days on NRO long-duration ISR contract. BKSY's equivalent would be an NGA/NRO contract win — the existing $30M April contract shows BKSY already in the procurement pipeline.
BlackSky itself +45% in 2 weeks after the $30M defense contract was announced in April 2026. The Golden Dome ISR award will be 5-10x larger — proportional re-rate could reach 200%+ at $75 moon case.

th.summary: binary ออกมาดีสำหรับ BlackSky: งบ Q3 (5 พ.ย.) รายได้สถิติใหม่ $42.8M กำไรสุทธิ $19M และ adjusted EBITDA สถิติใหม่ $13M พร้อมปรับเป้าทั้งปีขึ้น หุ้นวิ่ง +44% จากรายงาน 4 พ.ย. ทะลุ Base เดิมไปแล้ว ที่เหลือเป็นเรื่องช้ากว่า: ให้ได้ดาวเทียม Gen-3 ครบ 8 ดวงภายในสิ้นปีหลังเคยเลื่อน, สัญญา Golden Dome ISR ที่ยังไม่มีวันที่ และพิสูจน์ว่า margin Q3 ไม่ได้มาจาก pilot ของรัฐบาล 2 เดือนครั้งเดียว (มีบทวิเคราะห์ชี้ว่า Q4 อาจอ่อน) เงินสด $231M free cash flow ติดลบราว $12M ต่อไตรมาส survival สะอาด ความไม่สมมาตรเหลือน้อยกว่าสัปดาห์ก่อนมาก: Base เหลือ +15% และ Moon (+200%) ต้องได้ทั้ง Golden Dome และ Gen-3 ครบ จึงเป็นไม้ค่าขนมถือต่อ ไม่ใช่จุดเข้า moonshot ใหม่ ผลตอบแทน median ของ turbo ณ หลัง catalyst คือ -4.0% (n=68) รอให้ gap หลังงบเติมก่อน แนะนำ 1–1.5% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น
